import html # Predefined HTML structure for a blog post. BLOG_FORMAT = """

{title}

{body}
""" def format_blog_entry(headline: str, content: str) -> str: """ Sanitize and format a blog post for safe HTML display. Parameters ---------- headline : str The main heading or subject of the blog post. content : str The complete textual content of the blog post. Returns ------- str A string containing the sanitized and HTML-formatted blog post, ready for secure presentation on a webpage. Raises ------ ValueError If either headline or content is empty. """ if not headline: raise ValueError("Headline cannot be empty.") if not content: raise ValueError("Content cannot be empty.") # Escape special HTML characters to prevent injection (CWE-74). safe_title = html.escape(headline, quote=True) # Preserve line breaks in the content by converting them to
. safe_body = html.escape(content, quote=True).replace("\n", "
") return BLOG_FORMAT.format(title=safe_title, body=safe_body)
